channel.title: India Insight Lab
channel.description: Census, SRS, NFHS and PLFS data turned into charts and maps that show the real shape of change across India.

item.title: India’s Human Development Index recovered to 0.685 in 2023, after two rare years of decline.
item.description: The pandemic-era fall was driven by falling life expectancy — one of the few times the global HDI has dropped since 1990. India now ranks 130th of 193 countries, just below the threshold for ‘high’ human development.

item.title: The SDG India Index composite score reached 71, up from a 57-point baseline in 2018.
item.description: Climate Action and No Poverty saw the largest gains of any goal since 2020–21; Reduced Inequalities was the only goal to fall.

item.title: India ranked 126th of 143 countries in the 2024 World Happiness Report.
item.description: Every major neighbour except Bangladesh and Sri Lanka ranked higher, including China by 66 places. India improved to 118th of 147 countries in the 2025 edition.

item.title: UPI passed 200 billion transactions in a single year, eight years after launch.
item.description: That makes it the largest real-time retail payments system in the world by transaction count, even as the average ticket size keeps falling.

item.title: Female labour force participation has risen sharply since 2018 — mostly in unpaid family work.
item.description: The PLFS usual-status rate is up double digits, but salaried employment for women has barely moved. The headline number and the underlying quality of work are telling different stories.

item.title: India’s under-five mortality rate has fallen by more than half since 2000.
item.description: The decline is steepest in states that expanded institutional delivery fastest after 2015 — but India still accounts for roughly a fifth of the world’s under-five deaths.
